input_text: To prove that Mary was at the mall on January 2nd, a mall employee testifies that on January 2nd, Mary told him she was planning on purchasing several diamonds.

extraction.input_text: To prove that Mary was at the mall on January 2nd, a mall employee testifies that on January 2nd, Mary told him she was planning on purchasing several diamonds.

claim.text: Is the statement described in this narrative hearsay under FRE 801(c)?

arguments.text: The statement was made out of court, as Mary told the mall employee her plans on January 2nd prior to testifying.
arguments.legal_rule: FRE 801(c)(1) - hearsay requires an out-of-court statement.

arguments.text: The statement contains a clear assertion, specifically Mary's declaration that she was planning to purchase diamonds.
arguments.legal_rule: FRE 801(c)(2) - hearsay requires an assertion by the declarant.
arguments.evidence_span: she was planning on purchasing several diamonds

arguments.text: The statement is offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted, as it is introduced to establish that Mary was at the mall on January 2nd.
arguments.legal_rule: FRE 801(c)(3) - hearsay requires the statement be offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted.
arguments.evidence_span: To prove that Mary was at the mall on January 2nd

arguments.text: The statement may be offered for a non-hearsay purpose as circumstantial evidence of Mary's presence at the mall, independent of the truth of her plans.
arguments.legal_rule: Circumstantial evidence / non-assertive use does not constitute hearsay under FRE 801(c).
arguments.evidence_span: To prove that Mary was at the mall on January 2nd
